text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm at the academy early one morning,
still
yawning to myself when I catch sight
of Daiwa
Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Trainer. I'm the first one at
school again!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A model student is always early to bed
and early
to rise. I got my beauty sleep
last night, and now
my skin is flawless!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, someone can't stop yawning. Did you stay up too late?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then it's an early night for you tonight,
you hear?
I can't have you collapsing on
me!
